documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported a strong H1 FY27 with income of INR135.57 crores, representing a 79.91% year-on-year growth, and an EBITDA of INR23.62 crores. Management noted robust order inflows, securing 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores during the half year, bringing the total order book to over INR565.80 crores. The company expects full-year revenue for FY27 to be between INR300 crores and INR350 crores, while managing input cost pressures with price variation clauses covering 70% to 80% of its order book. Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported strong financial performance in H1 FY27, with total income growing 79.91% year-on-year to ₹135.57 Cr and net profit increasing 45.09% to ₹13.65 Cr, driven by healthy order book execution and robust end-market demand. The company secured 11 new orders worth ₹209.24 Cr during the first half, taking its total consolidated order book to ₹565.80 Cr as on October 21, 2026.

guidance.claim: The company expects full-year revenue for FY27 to be between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: This year, we believe -- we trust we should fetch revenue between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects the order book by the end of the year to be maintained between INR600 crores and INR800 crores.
guidance.quote: I think we believe, with the end of the year, we may maintain between -- the order book may maintain between INR600 crores and INR800 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects the top line for FY27 to be between INR250 crores and INR300 crores.
guidance.quote: So cautiously, we are telling between INR250 crores to INR300 crores we can make this year.

guidance.claim: PAT margin for FY27 is expected to be around 9% to 12%.
guidance.quote: And the PAT margin will be around, we believe it will be around 9% to 12%.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margins are expected to be maintained between 18% and 20%.
guidance.quote: It will be maintained between 18% to 20%.

guidance.claim: The company expects a minimum 30% year-on-year rise in revenue going forward.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, 30% -- minimum 30% rise will be there on the revenue.

guidance.claim: Peak revenue from both plants combined is projected to reach INR600 crores to INR650 crores by FY29.
guidance.quote: It will be INR600 crores to INR650 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the demand environment is very good due to interest from the Union and State governments in expanding the transmission network.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, now the demand environment is very good and the sector is also very good. Since the Union Government and the State Governments showing much interest in expanding the transmission network, the demand is very high.

demand_outlook.claim: Market information indicates a good demand for the power sector for the next 8 to 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As per market information, next 8 to 10 years, there will be good demand for this power sector.

demand_outlook.claim: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of the order book and continued demand across key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of our order book and continued demand across our key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Business momentum remains encouraging as the company progresses in line with its annual targets.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, business momentum remains encouraging, and we continue to progress in line with our targets for the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for transformers is very high and expected to sustain for at least 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: From the market information, at least minimum 10 years, this demand will sustain.

demand_outlook.claim: Order inflows remained strong during the quarter with 10 orders secured aggregating INR195.64 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Order inflows remained strong during the quarter. We secured 10 orders aggregating INR195.64 crores during Q1 FY27 with the execution time lines ranging between 7 months to 17 months.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for transformers is reported to be good globally as well as in India.
demand_outlook.quote: And not only in India, but overall global -- across globe, the demand is good. Demand is very good.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of the Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well.
capex_expansion.quote: Operationally, the ramp-up of our Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of the newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The ramp-up of our newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning tank manufacturing capacity with an estimated capex of INR20 crores to INR22 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, it's around INR20 crores, INR22 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Kannur manufacturing facility became operational during the previous quarter, bringing total capacity to approximately 9,000 MVA.
capex_expansion.quote: I would all like to brief touch upon our new Kannur manufacturing facility, which became operational during the previous quarter. The facility has strengthened our overall manufacturing capacity to approximately 9,000 MVA with capabilities extending up to 200 MVA, 220 kV.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted pressure from higher prices of key inputs, particularly CRGO steel and transformer oil.
margins_costs.quote: During the period, we have seen pressure from higher prices of key inputs, particularly CRGO steel and transformer oil.

margins_costs.claim: Around 70% to 75% of the order book is covered under price variation clauses.
margins_costs.quote: Importantly, around 70% to 75% of our order book is covered under price variation clauses, which provides a degree of protection against volatility in key raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27 primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs across key raw materials.
margins_costs.quote: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27, primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs, particularly across key raw materials.

margins_costs.claim: Around 70-75% of the order book is covered by price variation clauses which provides protection against significant raw material price movements.
margins_costs.quote: However, around 70–75% of our order book is covered by price variation clauses, which provides protection against significant movements in raw material prices and helps us manage cost volatility over the execution period.

margins_costs.claim: Management remains focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix and operating leverage as volumes scale up.
margins_costs.quote: We remain focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix and operating leverage as volumes scale up.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material price increases are absorbed and passed on because of price variation clauses in orders.
margins_costs.quote: So the margin was able to maintain and it was the reason it was absorbed, and it was passed out.

orders_capacity.claim: During H1 FY27, the company secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: During H1 FY27, we secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores, with execution timelines ranging between 7 months and 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores, providing strong execution visibility for the coming periods.

orders_capacity.claim: Peak revenue potential from both plants combined is up to INR550 crores to INR600 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, up to INR550 crores to INR600 crores will be the peak revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the order book of INR565 crores, distribution is around 16% to 17%, power transformers are 75% to 78%, and inverter duty transformers are 5%.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of this INR565 crores, distribution is around 16% to 17%, that is less than INR95 crores. And power transformer is around INR440 crores that comes around 78% -- 75% to 78%. And inverter duty transformers is around INR30 crores, that comes 5% of the total order book.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr during the first half, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.
orders_capacity.quote: We secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The current consolidated order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for coming quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expanded its geographic presence into Maharashtra during H1 FY27, broadening its customer and market base.
orders_capacity.quote: We also expanded our geographic presence into Maharashtra, further broadening our customer and market base.

orders_capacity.claim: The total order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026, providing healthy execution visibility over the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Power transformers constitute the largest share of the order book at INR453.83 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: From the product perspective, power transformers constitute the largest share on the order book at INR453.83 crores, representing approximately 76.91%.

orders_capacity.claim: Government orders represent approximately 30.10% of the total order book and nongovernment orders represent 69.9%.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of customer mix, government orders stand at INR177.6 crores, representing approximately 30.10% of the total order book, while nongovernment orders stands at INR412.46 crores, represent approximately 69.9%.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the new plant is currently at 20% to 25%.
orders_capacity.quote: The new plant, our capacity is almost 20% to 25% utilization as of now. We are utilizing 20% to 25%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has approached banks for higher working capital and term loan limits.
capital_allocation.quote: Now we have approached the banks for higher limits.

capital_allocation.claim: There is no requirement for equity dilution for the current financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: So for this year, there is no requirement for equity dilution.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost movements can impact margins due to timing differences between cost increases and PVC adjustments.
risks_headwinds.quote: These movements can impact margins, especially where there is a timing difference between increase in input costs and the corresponding adjustment under the price variation clause.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues caused raw material price fluctuations during the period.
risks_headwinds.quote: And though there was a geopolitical issues were there due to that, the price rise of the raw materials are being absorbed because of this price variation clause, which we get from our buyers.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve peak revenue of INR550 crores next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes. We are expecting -- actually in earlier calls, in next 2 years we would achieve the INR600 crores. But now things are moving in good direction and I think next year we can go up to INR550 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to migrate to the main board of the stock exchange at an appropriate time.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, we have a plan. In an appropriate time, we will definitely come into the main board.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to maintain its order book between INR500 crores and INR600 crores going forward.
management_commitments.quote: Maintained between INR500 crores to INR600 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Construction for the tank manufacturing facility is expected to be completed before March.
management_commitments.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
